title: Best Free Document Scanner Apps for Android Without Watermarks or Subscriptions
html:
You need to scan a signed rent agreement, an electricity bill for passport verification, or college assignment pages to submit as a single PDF. You download a popular scanner app from the Play Store, snap four pages, and tap "Export PDF".

Last updated: 25 Nov 2026. This productivity guide reviews the best completely free document scanner apps for Android that produce crisp, high-contrast PDFs with zero watermarks, zero pop-up advertisements, and zero expensive recurring subscriptions.

Suddenly, the app demands ₹799 per month for a "Premium VIP Pass". If you decline, it slaps an ugly watermark across the bottom of every page: "Scanned with CamScanner". Submitting a professional legal document or job application with an app watermark looks thoroughly unprofessional.

The good news? You do not need to pay a single rupee or tolerate watermarks. Multiple world-class document scanners are 100% free with zero strings attached.

The Best Free Document Scanners Compared

Scanner Application Watermark? Free Optical Character Recognition (OCR)? Cloud Account Required? Ads / Cost
Microsoft Lens Zero Watermark Yes (Exports to Word / Excel) Optional (Can save locally) 100% Free / Zero Ads
Google Drive (Built-in) Zero Watermark Yes (Searchable PDF in Drive) Google Account Pre-installed / Zero Ads
OpenScan Zero Watermark Yes (Local on-device OCR) Zero (100% Offline & Open Source) 100% Free / Zero Ads
vFlat Scan Zero Watermark Yes (High-accuracy book curvature fix) Optional Free tier (Great for thick books)

1. Microsoft Lens: The Best All-Around Business Scanner

Formerly known as Office Lens, Microsoft Lens is the undisputed king of free mobile document digitization. It contains zero advertisements, adds zero watermarks, and does not push paid in-app upgrades.

Standout Features:

  • Multi-Mode Processing: Offers specialized color filters for Document (crisp black text on pure white paper), Whiteboard (removes fluorescent light glare), and Business Card (extracts contact details automatically).
  • Free OCR Export: Point your camera at a printed table, scan it, and Lens can export the data directly into an editable Microsoft Word document or formatted Excel spreadsheet with astonishing accuracy.
  • Local Storage Saving: You can save multi-page PDFs directly to your phone's internal storage without uploading them to OneDrive.

2. Google Drive Built-in Scanner: The Instant Shortcut

You probably already have a world-class document scanner sitting in your app drawer without realizing it.

  1. Open the pre-installed Google Drive app on your Android phone.
  2. Tap the floating Camera icon in the bottom right corner (or long-press the Google Drive home screen icon → tap Scan).
  3. Hold your camera over the page. Google's machine learning camera automatically detects document borders, straightens perspective distortion, flattens shadows, and captures the image without tapping any buttons.
  4. Tap the + icon to add additional pages, apply the Clean Black & White filter, and tap Save.

3. OpenScan: The 100% Offline Open-Source Champion

If you are scanning sensitive documents (passports, tax filings, Aadhaar cards, medical histories) and refuse to let any scanner app connect to the internet, OpenScan (available on F-Droid and Play Store) is the privacy gold standard.

Developed as a direct non-profit response to invasive Chinese scanner apps, OpenScan operates 100% offline with zero internet permissions. It has zero tracking code, zero analytics, and performs document flattening and PDF compilation entirely using local on-device algorithms.

Summary: The Perfect Toolkit

  • For general paperwork and OCR to Word/Excel: Use Microsoft Lens.
  • For quick 1-page receipts and bills: Use the Google Drive Camera shortcut.
  • For sensitive medical and financial documents: Use OpenScan.

faq.title: Does Microsoft Lens add any watermark to scanned PDFs?
faq.description: No. Microsoft Lens creates completely clean, professional PDFs with zero watermarks, logos, or promotional tags.

faq.title: Can you scan multi-page documents into a single PDF file?
faq.description: Yes. Both Microsoft Lens and Google Drive allow you to continuously photograph multiple pages and compile them into a single organized PDF document.

faq.title: Is OpenScan safe for sensitive documents like passports?
faq.description: Yes. OpenScan is open-source and has zero internet permissions, meaning it is mathematically incapable of transmitting your scanned document images to remote cloud servers.
